header.sector: Optical interconnects, transceivers and datacenter networking
header.title: Marvell-Lumentum merger unites optical and electronic capabilities to challenge Broadcom

s01_bottom_line.text: TrendForce estimates the combined Marvell-Lumentum entity would hold nearly 7% of the semiconductor wired communications market, ranking behind only NVIDIA and Broadcom, combining Marvell's electronic/DSP strengths with Lumentum's InP laser and optical components. ⟨cited figures: forecast; approximate⟩

TrendForce frames the deal as reshaping the optical communications competitive landscape, giving NVIDIA and CSPs broader electro-optical sourcing options and potentially reducing reliance on Broadcom.

If completed, the merger would create a more integrated electro-optical competitor that could take share from Broadcom in AI optical interconnects as the industry moves to CPO/NPO; the article does not quantify revenue, earnings or valuation effects for any issuer.

items.text: TrendForce estimates the combined company's market share would reach nearly 7%, placing it behind only NVIDIA and Broadcom. ⟨cited figures: forecast; approximate⟩
